person.name: Alex Morgan
person.title: Junior Full Stack Developer
person.availability: Open to junior full stack & frontend roles

about: Junior Full Stack Developer with a Diploma in Web Development from the (fictional) Northbridge Coding Academy.

I bring eight years in hospitality and event management, so I'm used to fast-moving teams, demanding customers and staying calm when things go sideways. Now I put that same care into building clean, accessible web apps.

I work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, React and Django, plus SQL and NoSQL databases. I use AI tools every day for debugging, code review and prototyping, and I test and own everything I ship.

highlight.title: AI & Modern Development Practices
highlight.text: I use AI assistants daily for code generation, debugging and architecture planning, which helps me ship features faster while keeping quality high.
